name: Community Conditions & Active Priorities
cache_policy: Cache by government, school, authority, utility or institution entity plus record type, period and source URL; never duplicate the same record merely because related ZIP inputs differ.
presentation_policy: Render only categories with usable information. Keep Research Needed prominent for material nonpublic or project-specific questions, not as repeated empty cards.
recommendation_gate: A potential response must trace to sourced conditions, identify the current response and remaining gap, pass durability and operating-sustainability tests, and retain human review.
excluded_as_standalone_benefit: one-time donations without an operating plan
